AuthNull Release Notes Week of August, 2024

Posted Aug 2, 2024 Updated Oct 9, 2024
By Asif Ali 1 min read

Secrets Management - UI

We’re announcing the availability of Secrets management screen which allows users to lookup their secrets from their current secret store - which today defaults to the wallet.

When a user visits the secrets screen to view the secrets, the wallet is notified and upon user’s permission, the secrets are retrieved from the wallet and displayed on screen.

This current version of secrets management allows users to manage their own secrets on their phone. Future versions might include support for third party secrets server.

Logs UI

This release also contains a separate screen showcasing all the logs from all endpoints that you have provisioned, active directory and endpoint authentication logs. These logs are configured and collected using Fluentbit, and can be forwarded to a SIEM of your choice.
